item.title: Samsung Biologics Strike
item.description:
• Summary: Workers at Samsung Biologics, a major contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) in South Korea, initiated a five-day strike over wage disputes. The strike involves labor union members demanding higher pay and better working conditions. The work stoppage could disrupt manufacturing schedules for biopharmaceutical clients relying on the CDMO for drug substance production. Samsung Biologics is a key supplier for several global biotech and pharma companies, and the strike highlights tensions in the contract manufacturing sector.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Pharma

item.title: CBER Leadership Changes
item.description:
• Summary: CBER director Peter Marks steps aside, with Nicoletta Szarama stepping in as acting director. The search for a permanent successor continues, ending a tumultuous tenure for Marks. The change in leadership at the FDA's biologics center is a significant industry event with implications for regulatory oversight of biologics and gene therapies.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: FierceBiotech, BioSpace

item.title: Obesity Drugs Excluded from Compounding List
item.description:
• Summary: The FDA has excluded popular obesity drugs such as semaglutide and tirzepatide from the compounding list, limiting compounding pharmacies' ability to produce cheaper versions. This decision represents a setback for companies like AstraZeneca and may affect patient access.
  • MoAs: GLP-1 receptor agonists, GIP/GLP-1 dual agonists
  • Sources: STAT News
